verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee documents AI-based semantic extraction (ai_query / ai_extract_rules) and pass-through ChatGPT and Gemini query APIs. These are adjacent capabilities: one pulls fields from scraped pages, the other proxies LLM prompts. Neither is a feature that analyzes the user's own data and surfaces insights or suggestions inside the product. No evidence shows an in-product insights or recommendations feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
